response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(ra.avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(ra.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(ra.per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price FROM rating_averages AS ra CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean AS crm WHERE ra.per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price;
